papers.title: Reinforcement Learning without Ground-Truth Solutions can Improve LLMs
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for training LLMs typically rely on ground-truth answers to assign rewards, limiting their applicability to tasks where the ground-truth solution is unknown. We introduce a \textbf{R}anking-\textbf{i}nduced \textbf{VER}ifiable framework (RiVER) that trains LLMs on score-based optimization tasks without ground-truth solutions, using deterministic execution feedback as continuous-valued supervision. When applying group-relative RL to such conti
papers.llm_reason: 最强即时信号，且证据强度高于其余即时类论文：RiVER 直击 RLVR（可验证奖励 RL）的应用天花板——过去只能训'有标准答案的任务'（数学/代码），而 RAG 召回、摘要、排序、开放生成这类任务只有打分器、没有 ground-truth 正解，长期困在 SFT/DPO。它把'可验证'从'知道正解'重定义为'存在一个确定的可执行打分信号（连续值也算）'，再套 group-relative RL（GRPO 类）直接吃连续奖励。理论命题清晰且可证伪（RLVR 边界由'是否有确定性可执行打分'决定，而非'是否有正解'）；工程映射即插即用（手里已有的检索相关性/ROUGE/NDCG 打分器直接当 reward）。证据来自'有 ground-truth 的 RLVR vs 无 ground-truth 的 score-based RLVR'的对照（摘要指出后者此前不可行），作者（Lin/Gao/Kuang/Huang/Zhou，RAG/对话/RL 方向）可信。唯一减分项：代码/benchmark/复现入口暂无（待核验），故不给 90+。

papers.title: Empowering GUI Agents via Autonomous Experience Exploration and Hindsight Experience Utilization for Task Planning
papers.abstract: Multimodal web agents can assist humans in operating repetitive GUI tasks, where effective task planning is essential for decomposing complex tasks into executable actions. While small open source MLLMs are cost efficient and privacy preserving compared with commercial large models, they suffer from weak planning and limited cross website generalization. papers.llm_reason: Agent 工程主线的强即时信号：小模型 MLLM（开源、低成本、隐私友好）做 GUI/Web agent 时'规划弱、跨站点泛化差'是真痛点。PEEU 给两段式解法——自主经验探索（离线让 agent 探索环境积累轨迹）+ 事后经验利用（hindsight，把走过的轨迹重新当训练信号回放重标），用小模型逼近商业大模型的规划能力。理论命题=把'探索得到的历史轨迹'作为可复用训练资产（hindsight relabeling），而非每次从零规划；工程映射=给自有 agent 框架加'离线探索→轨迹回放→任务规划'闭环，直接降本。证据含方法+对照（开源 MLLM vs 商业大模型），关键词覆盖 agent/planning/multimodal；作者（Men/Jin/Cao/Chen/Liu，中科院 agent 方向）可信。减分项同上：代码/benchmark 待核验，方法细节尚需精读全文确认探索与 hindsight 的具体配比。

papers.title: Hallucination in World Models is Predictable and Preventable
papers.abstract: Modern generative world models render increasingly realistic action-controllable futures, yet they frequently hallucinate: rollouts remain visually fluent while drifting from the ground-truth dynamics. We hypothesize that hallucination concentrates in low-coverage regions of the state-action space, where lightweight data-centric signals can both detect it and guide mitigation. papers.llm_reason: 证据强度最高（唯一随文发布评测资产）：世界模型 rollout'视觉流畅但偏离真实动力学'的幻觉被定位为集中在'状态-动作空间低覆盖区'，且可用轻量数据信号检测并缓解；配套 MMBench2（427 小时、210 任务、带 ground-truth 动作的可视化世界建模基准）。理论命题可证伪（幻觉根因是数据覆盖而非模型容量，且可预测可预防）；工程映射=世界模型/视频生成 agent 上线前加一道'状态-动作覆盖度'体检，低覆盖区即幻觉高发区。作者（Hansen/Wang，UCSD 世界模型方向）高度可信。给趋势分而非即时分，因属评测方法论+可靠性治理，非即插即用工具，且需先确认 MMBench2 是否已公开下载入口（待核验）。

papers.title: When are likely answers right? On Sequence Probability and Correctness in LLMs
papers.abstract: Many decoding methods for large language models can be understood as shifting probability mass toward outputs that are more likely under the model, either locally at the token level or globally at the sequence level. Therefore, their success depends on a fundamental question: when does sequence probability, that is, the conditional probability of a continuation given a prompt, actually align with correctness? papers.abstract: Modern image generation demands a single model that unifies diverse capabilities, including text-to-image (T2I), local editing, and global editing.
